name: DomainOnlyAccessPolicy
description: This Policy adds restrictions so that users will have access to domain related data. If the user has some domain, then he will be able to access data only for that domain. If the user does not have any domain assigned , he will be able to access only assets which also does not have any domain.

rules.name: DomainAccessDenyRule
rules.description: Deny access when domain check fails

rules.name: DomainAccessAllowRule
rules.description: Allow access when domain check passes

rules.name: DomainAccessDenyAdministrationRule
rules.description: Deny changing policies, roles, bots and apps, which control access, whatever their domain

rules.name: DomainAccessDenyTeamAndUserRule
rules.description: Deny changing teams and users that are in no domain, and bot users
